content.user_title: Capture Workflow Lessons and Improve Skills
content.value_statement: Useful workflow lessons disappear between work sessions. Task Observer records reusable observations and guides reviews that produce staged skill updates.
actual_capabilities: Record workflow patterns, user corrections, and rule violations as Markdown observations with YAML metadata.
Check existing observations and related skill families before creating duplicate entries.
Maintain observation statuses, archive resolved entries, and track issued identifiers.
Review observations and stage proposed changes without editing installed skills directly.
Convert legacy single-file observation logs using the bundled Python migration script.
Validate skill folders and package them into ZIP-based skill bundles.
limitations: Persistent capture requires a writable workspace; environments without storage use a handoff document.
Automatic activation requires explicit configuration or supported harness hooks; description matching alone is not enforceable.
Generated improvements require review and installation; staging does not update installed skills.
The audit identified permission-bypass instructions and release-workflow shell injection that require remediation.

faq.question: Which assistants does Task Observer support?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Activation and available tools depend on the host environment.

faq.question: Where are observations stored?
faq.answer: Each observation is a Markdown file in the configured persistent workspace. Resolved entries move into its archive directory.

faq.question: Does it run automatically?
faq.answer: Reliable automatic activation requires explicit instructions or supported harness hooks. Description matching alone does not guarantee activation.

faq.question: Does it change my installed skills?
faq.answer: The documented workflow stages proposed updates for review and installation. It does not treat staging as permission to replace installed skills.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Routine observation capture is local. Requested upstream feedback and public repository review workflows can require network access.

faq.question: What security concerns did the audit identify?
faq.answer: The audit found denied-write retry instructions and release tag shell injection. The omitted static matches also require manual review before automatic publication.
